title: 1mol
tagline: 1mol is a DeFi protocol built on top of the 1inch Aqua to easier earning on that.
description: 1mol is the "Lido" on the 1inch Aqua and more than that.To solve the problems that individual's high gas,single side risk,unstable earning,etc, I built the 1mol.1mol is for unified allocating the fund for higher efficiency and earning.It brings the yield token to the system creating much more DeFi liquidity and depth for the ecosystem.
how_its_made:
I use the 1inch Aqua SDK and related Github repo for developing.I use the React.It is a TS full stack project.It use TailwindCSS,TS,HTML for FE.And it uses viem,wagmi,RainbowKit for BE and view for simple indexing.Solidity and hardhat for contract.
Its spirit comes from "Lido" and more scaling unified fund project.This is more than "Lido".It will brave a new paradigm of self-custody LP market making.
